amendments.body: Include `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1-336` in version control. It is currently untracked (`git status` shows `??`), so the actual patch produced by `git diff` does not contain any of the new acceptance-criteria coverage for nitrification-driven alkalinity depletion, pH decline, or the soft-vs-hard buffering contrast.
amendments.rationale: As submitted, the change lands the production-code behavior but not the regression tests that are supposed to lock it in.

amendments.body: Fix the new tracing metric exposed from `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:13-23,343-346` and logged in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-239`. `total_mg_n_nitrified` is reported as `nob_step + comammox_step` (nitrate produced), while alkalinity consumption is computed from `aob_step + comammox_step` (TAN oxidation). In ticks where AOB outruns NOB and nitrite accumulates, the trace will report little or zero `nitrogen_cycle.total_n_nitrified_mg` alongside a non-zero `nitrogen_cycle.alk_consumed_meq`. Either rename the metric to nitrate production or change it to total TAN oxidation so the diagnostics stay internally consistent.
amendments.rationale: The new trace contract is meant to explain nitrification-driven alkalinity loss; right now it becomes scientifically contradictory in a common transient state.

amendments.body: Add a reusable alkalinity-return accounting surface instead of only a constant. `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:19-27` defines `DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N`, but the public/runtime interface is still nitrification-only (`NitrogenCycleOutput::alkalinity_consumed_meq` in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:15-23` and the hard-coded `nitrogen_cycle.alk_consumed_meq` note in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:236-238`). E4b will still need another API/trace-schema change to represent alkalinity return, so the promised denitrification return path is not actually prepared yet.
amendments.rationale: Without a symmetric or generic alkalinity-delta surface now, downstream budget/trace consumers will need another redesign when denitrification is implemented.

payload.summary: Reviewed the diff and the touched implementation/test files end-to-end. I found three material issues: the new regression file is not part of the actual patch because it is untracked, the new nitrification trace metric under-reports alkalinity-driving TAN oxidation whenever nitrite accumulates, and the denitrification return path is not actually represented by a reusable accounting interface yet.
